{
  "name": "fine-print",
  "version": "0.1.1",
  "description": "A second reader that flags what you would miss in a wall of text.",
  "homepage": "https://modmyclaude.com/mods/fine-print",
  "repository": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods/tree/main/mods/fine-print#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://modmyclaude.com/privacy",
  "termsOfServiceUrl": "https://modmyclaude.com/terms",
  "author": {
    "name": "modmyclaude"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "review",
    "safety",
    "cost",
    "security",
    "insight",
    "band"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "watchFor": {
      "type": "string",
      "multiple": true,
      "title": "Watch for",
      "description": "Topics Fine Print flags: cost, security, data-loss, irreversible, customers, assumptions. 'all' means every topic, 'none' turns checks off.",
      "default": [
        "cost",
        "security",
        "data-loss",
        "irreversible",
        "customers",
        "assumptions"
      ]
    },
    "maxChecksPerSession": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Max checks per session",
      "description": "Spend cap: how many small-model checks Fine Print may run in one session. 0 turns checks off.",
      "default": 30,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 1000
    }
  }
}
